PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_ColumnCommon
PropertySetDef.Definition: Definition from IAI: Properties common to the definition of all IfcColumn.

PropertyDef.Name: Reference
PropertyDef.Definition: Reference ID for this column type in this project (e.g. type "C-1")

PropertyDef.Name: Length
PropertyDef.Definition: Specified or derived length of the Column. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

PropertyDef.Name: Width
PropertyDef.Definition: Specified or derived witdth of the Column. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

PropertyDef.Name: Height
PropertyDef.Definition: Specified or derived Height of the Column. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

PropertyDef.Name: SlendernessRatio
PropertyDef.Definition: Calculated slenderness ratio for this column
